visual_brief.subject: AlphaProof Code uses AI agents and human guidance to produce machine-checked proof artifacts for Signal protocol code
verified_context: Google DeepMind says its agentic framework, with substantial human guidance, proved key security properties of code underlying Signal's cryptographic protocol.
The team released formal-verification artifacts, while the bounded reporting pass did not identify an independent audit of the complete effort.
The proof applies to stated properties, defined code and explicit assumptions; it is not a guarantee that the whole production system is secure.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Layered implementation channels must pass through a sequence of independent physical proof gates before one verified segment can continue.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Several dark stone code channels cross precise terracotta verification apertures, while one unverified branch stops before the final gate.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. Three physical proof gates constrain the layered implementation channels, one branch stops before acceptance, and the visible human guidance is directly supported by the reported workflow.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected at the constitutional gate because the central specimen contains code-like pseudo-text and reads as an instrument diagram.
candidate_notes.C: Rejected after comparison. The proof bridge is visually strong, but the large landscape and group of people turn a bounded verification result into an unsupported heroic scene.

crop_review.article_desktop: The layered channels, three terracotta proof apertures, stopped branch and human-guidance cue remain visible in the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains all three gates, the accepted channels and the stopped branch; the hand remains a secondary cue.
crop_review.thumbnail: The dark channels passing through three terracotta gates remain distinct at 320px.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the research references through a warm paper field, restrained charcoal forms, sparse terracotta intervention, tactile laboratory materiality and a bounded story-specific silhouette.
